args.body:
• Apparel return rates reached 24% in 2026, highlighting the scale of retail returns logistics.
• Consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth (20%).
• Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the original margin.

Sources: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns and https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion
args.title: Retail Returns: Combined Summary (Bellwether Blog + Companion)
